blurb: Eugene Skydivers has been operating at Creswell airport since 1992, specializing in tandem skydiving for first-time jumpers. Instructors are fully licensed and certified by the United States Parachute Association with thousands of skydives. Guests experience skydiving from nearly 2 miles above the earth with views of the Willamette Valley and surrounding mountain ranges.
